propositions: Integrate task-decomposition SOTA recommendations R1-R7 into the plan-review gate, each validated by its own eval gate before implementation.
Validation is eval-based (experiments E1/E2/E3/E5/E6, with E4 dropped) rather than A/B testing, with post-ship dogfooding via R7 instrumentation.
The original batch-eval-gated plan was retired in favor of an advisory-first posture plus standing zero-LLM dogfood effectiveness monitoring, an operator-approved cost decision.
E1's finding-adjudication inter-rater kappa corpus was invalidated as tool-less and plan-truncated (~79% contaminated) and descoped, while the 628-row outcome corpus was frozen and committed.
E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baselines were permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5 (criterion_effectiveness.py), with mining confirmed dead against real baseline counts.
R2's evidence-kind lint is a DET floor check in det_floor.py and does not route through criteria_routing.json, avoiding file conflicts with R3/R4.
